description: Checks a log of takes against the plan it was shot from, before you rely on it. It finds shots that are not in the plan, take numbers used twice, one op_id used for two different takes, file names written as paths, and a log made for another film or another revision of the plan. Each problem has a path into the log and a fix. A log with errors is a normal answer, not an error. The log is text about recordings (shot ids, verdicts, file names, timecodes). The tools take text only, never video or audio, and no AI model runs. Input: plan (a dpl.plan/1 object) and takes (a dpl.takes/1 object). Output: dpl.diagnostics/1 with valid (true or false) and each diagnostic with its fix. We don't keep the plan or the take log. Needs an agent key from a Shoot Plan account. Free, and it does not count toward the account's 3 free projects a month. Plans up to 8 MB and 120 calls a minute (5,000 a day).

plan.description: The plan itself: a dpl.plan/1 JSON object (not text inside a string). Call shoot_plan_format for the schema links and an example.

takes.description: The take log: a dpl.takes/1 JSON object, {format, work_id, takes: [...]}. Each take has op_id, shot (the plan's shot id), kind and verdict; file names and timecodes are optional. A take log holds text about recordings: the tools take no video or audio.

name: shoot_plan_validate_takes
title: Check a take log against its plan
